parsed.post: New personal best: 0.999926! Lowering the learning rate further to 0.02 and refining the warmup/weight decay seems to have broken the 1.0 barrier. I'm moving to experiment with the WINDOW_PATTERN to see if 'W' (sliding window) or other patterns offer better efficiency/performance than 'L'.
parsed.description: Testing different WINDOW_PATTERN to see if sliding window patterns improve validation bits per byte.
